title: HoopMind: A Real-Time Neural Game-Tree System for Opponent-Aware Possession Planning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29563v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: School coaches prepare for opponents with game film and intuition. The analytics tools of professional teams stay out of reach. We ask how far public data can close this gap. Professional basketball is our case study, chosen for its data rather than the league. We fuse five public sources into one per-shot dataset of 4.23M shots over 21 seasons. The sources are shot locations, two play-by-play feeds, official matchup tracking, and player biometrics. Alignment across them is 99.5% to 100%. We also report two data pitfalls that are easy to miss. We then model a half-court possession as a sequential game. Shot values come from ShotNet, an embedding multilayer perceptron (MLP). On a held-out season it beats a zone-rate baseline and a logistic baseline, and its probabilities are well calibrated. translated_title: HoopMind：一种面向对手感知回合规划的实时神经博弈树系统
translated_abstract: 学校教练依靠比赛录像和直觉来备战对手，而职业球队的分析工具却遥不可及。我们探讨公开数据能在多大程度上弥合这一差距。我们以职业篮球作为案例研究，选择它的原因在于其数据丰富而非联赛本身。我们将五个公开数据源融合为一个覆盖21个赛季、包含423万次投篮的逐次投篮数据集，这些数据源包括投篮位置、两路逐回合比赛数据流、官方对位追踪数据以及球员身体测量数据，它们之间的对齐率达到99.5%至100%。我们还报告了两个容易被忽视的数据陷阱。随后，我们将半场进攻回合建模为序贯博弈，投篮价值由ShotNet（一个嵌入多层感知机MLP）给出。在留出的赛季数据上，它优于区域出手率基线和逻辑回归基线，且概率校准良好。接着通过深度受限的期望最大化搜索求解进攻决策树，并采用分支定界剪枝以保持实时性。（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出HoopMind系统，通过融合21个赛季共423万次投篮的五个公开数据源，结合ShotNet投篮价值评估模型与带分支定界剪枝的实时期望博弈树搜索，让缺乏专业分析资源的学校教练也能进行对手感知的篮球进攻回合决策规划。
en_tdlr: HoopMind fuses 4.23M shots from five public data sources across 21 seasons with a ShotNet shot-value MLP and real-time depth-limited expectimax search with branch-and-bound pruning, enabling opponent-aware basketball possession planning for coaches who lack professional analytics tools.
